Garhwal Himalayas · Guided treks

Treks that start at our doorstep.

Trained local guides. All permits handled. JuneGiri as your base camp before and after. Treks from beginner-friendly day hikes to 7-day high-altitude crossings.

Plan my trek →
Home / Treks
Choose your trek

Six treks. One base camp.

Every trek starts and ends with a rest night at JuneGiri Farms, proper meals, hot showers, and warm beds before and after the mountains.

Moderate

Valley of Flowers

📅 6 days⛰ 4,329m📍 Jul-Sep

UNESCO World Heritage site. 600+ flower species in bloom. Pairs naturally with Hemkund Sahib pilgrimage on the same route.

₹18,500 per person
Book →
Moderate

Har Ki Dun

📅 7 days⛰ 3,566m📍 Apr-Nov

The "Valley of Gods", a glacial cradle hugged by Swargarohini peaks. Lush forests, ancient villages, Pandav legend on every turn.

₹22,000 per person
Book →
Easy

Chopta-Tungnath-Chandrashila

📅 4 days⛰ 4,000m📍 Year-round

The most beginner-friendly Himalayan summit. World's highest Shiva temple at Tungnath. 360° peak views from Chandrashila top.

₹12,500 per person
Book →
Challenging

Kuari Pass

📅 6 days⛰ 4,264m📍 Apr-Jun, Sep-Nov

Lord Curzon's classic trek. Views of Nanda Devi, Kamet, Trishul, and Hathi-Ghoda Parbat. Best snow-trekking option in spring.

₹19,500 per person
Book →
Easy

Nag Tibba

📅 2 days⛰ 3,022m📍 Year-round

The "Serpent's Peak", perfect weekend trek from JuneGiri. Camp at the summit, watch sunrise hit the Bandarpunch range.

₹6,500 per person
Book →
Challenging

Roopkund (Skeleton Lake)

📅 8 days⛰ 5,029m📍 May-Oct

The mystery lake at 5,000m. Ancient skeletons, alpine meadows of Bedni Bugyal, and views of Trisul. Currently restricted, check status.

₹26,000 per person

What's included

Trained guides. All permits. Real food.

🥾

Certified mountain guides

All our guides hold NIM/IMF certification. 5+ years field experience.

⛺

Quality gear

4-season tents, sleeping bags rated to -10°C, technical kitchen tents.

🍛

Hot meals on trail

Full kitchen with our cook. No instant noodles, proper dal-rice every day.

📡

Safety protocols

Oxygen cylinders, satellite phone, evacuation plan for every trek.
